profile.name: DXP数字脉冲处理器
profile.description: 这是一类用于辐射探测器读出的数字脉冲处理与多道能谱采集电子学，常与X射线探测器配合使用，对探测器信号进行整形、计数和能谱分析。它常用于X射线荧光、同步辐射和其他能谱测量实验中。
profile.description_en: This is a digital pulse-processing and multichannel spectroscopy instrument used with radiation detectors, commonly X-ray detectors, to shape signals, count events, and acquire energy spectra. It is commonly used in X-ray fluorescence, synchrotron, and other spectroscopic measurements.
